chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd, from Yaḥyā al-Ḥalabī, from Burayd ibn Muʿāwiyah, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام), who said:

Indeed, ʿAlī (عليه السلام) was knowledgeable, and knowledge is inherited; and no knowledgeable one will perish except that there remains after him one who knows his knowledge, or whatever Allah wills.

key_terms.الْعِلْمُ: the transmitted sacred knowledge referred to in the narration
key_terms.عَالِمًا: possessing knowledge; one endowed with true knowledge
key_terms.عِلْمَهُ: his knowledge; the knowledge belonging to the preceding knower
key_terms.يُتَوَارَثُ: is inherited or passed down successively

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith show that the knowledge of Imam ʿAlī (عليه السلام) continued after him?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms that Imam ʿAlī (عليه السلام) possessed divinely transmitted knowledge and that such knowledge continues through inheritance from one rightful bearer to another. It indicates the continuity of sacred knowledge after the passing of each Imam, underscoring the enduring presence of divinely guided authority.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Yahya Al Halby, from Bureyd Bin Muawiya, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Surely, Ali<sup>asws</sup> was a Knowledgeable one, and the Knowledge is inherited and the knowledgeable one will never pass away except that there would remain from after him<sup>asws</sup> the one<sup>asws</sup> who knows his<sup>asws</sup> knowledge, or whatever Allah<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Yahya al-Halabi from Burayd ibn Mu‘awiya from Muhammad ibn Muslim from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.
“Ali (a.s.) was a man of knowledge and knowledge is inherited. Whenever a man of knowledge dies he leave another man of knowledge behind who possess his knowledge or whatever Allah wants.”
